name: XACT OMXC25

The index applies weight restrictions from individual issuers (capping). The composition of the index is normally adjusted bi-annually with regard to the transferable securities included as well as the percentage of the index to ensure sensitivity to market performance. The selection criteria and other adjustments to the composition of the index are governed by the Nasdaq OMX Copenhagen 25 Index Methodology.
